title: Canada and Austria to hold joint press conference in Ottawa
excerpt: Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand and Austrian Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger will meet for a media availability on November 6, 2026.
bodyHtml:
The Government of Canada announced that the Honourable Anita Anand, Minister of Foreign Affairs, and Her Excellency Beate Meinl-Reisinger, Federal Minister for European and International Affairs of the Republic of Austria, will participate in a joint press conference. The event is scheduled to take place on November 6, 2026, at 01:45 PM ET.

The press conference will be held at the West Block Foyer in Ottawa. The media availability is restricted to accredited members of the Canadian Parliamentary Press Gallery. Members of the media who are not accredited with the press gallery may send a message to pressres2@parl.gc.ca to obtain temporary access to the news conference.

For further information regarding the event, the Media Relations Office at Global Affairs Canada can be reached via email at media@international.gc.ca. The press conference is taking place during the visit of the Federal Minister for European and International Affairs of the Republic of Austria to Ottawa.
